newsitem.title: UK: Dorling shares slide after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Dorling shares slide after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in publishing group Dorling Kindersley Holdings Plc were indicated 76p lower at 245p on Tuesday after the company said that full year profits would be lower than last year.

Dorling said in a statement that its pre-tax profit for the year to June 30 1996 had been restated as 12.9 million stg to reflect a change in accounting policy in respect of multimedia development costs. The previously published figure was 17.4 million stg.
Dorling shares pulled back to 272.5p, down 48.5p, by 0839 GMT.
The company said that its profits would fall as a result of difficult trading conditions in the U.S. retail market, increased investment in its direct selling business and adverse currency movements.
Dorling warned in December that the pound/dollar rate could hit its full-year profits. Its shares have halved in value since that initial warning.
